note: The reviewed contract baseline of the OpenAPI/JSON:API public surface (#1583, epic #1577). The PR that changes this file IS the review: scripts/release_gates.py reads the answer, never re-asks it. When the first stable release is cut, a later reviewed PR flips mode to 'released', names the version and source tag here and commits that release's generated OpenAPI document as the snapshot to diff against.

measured.consequence: there is no previously supported stable release to diff a candidate's public contract against - measured, not assumed

declared_on: Q1/Q2/Q5/Q6 of #1578 - the register is Pending; scripts/decisions records the human answers (this knob is the gate's reading of Q2 option A, active only once a released baseline exists, and superseded by the recorded answer)

issue #1583 - while no baseline exists, the reviewed evidence a breaking change still owes is the #1580 classification, a '**Breaking:**' line in the changelog, the exceptions ledger and the migration notes
policy.note: pre-baseline refuses to be an anything-goes window: version and upgrade keep enforcing what every breaking change owes. The first published release replaces this manifest in its own reviewed pull request.
